strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
As I told you earlier, we'll hold this position ourselves.
We're guarding the rear of the units that went in, right?
Yes... Splitting into small units has weakened each one...
We can't let reinforcements come at them from behind.
Honestly, this is pretty rough...
Saying that won't make the enemy wait. But... these guys...
Isn't that the Dancougar...!?
Hey, what's going on!
I don't know, but that sinister aura... I can pretty much guess...
Shapiro...
Leave the fake-busting to us!
Oh! Not bad, Cyber Beast Force.
But there are still more of them. Shinobu! Don't slack off!
I know! The Dancougar's got way more than this!
Still, it feels like we're finally back in top form.
Now that it's tuned up, we can put out close to 100% power.
Huh? Enemy reinforcements!?
The mysterious enemy again... the Einst...
Don't tell me this plant planet is their doing too...!?
Where the hell do these things keep coming from?
Who knows. They show up all over the place.
J-Judau...
Hm... You okay, Ple?
That thing... there's something... I don't like it.
Yeah... I feel it too. Their will's getting stronger and stronger.
But we have to win.
That thing's bad news, all right.
You think so too, Ple Two?
Yeah. It's vague... but I just have a bad feeling about it.
Captain Quattro... What about Excellen!?
She doesn't seem to be here... But we can't afford to worry about her now.
Hey, Quattro! If we catch those things, think we'd learn anything?
No... There's no point questioning things we can't even talk to.
What on earth... is going on?
Anyway, we've gotta clean those things up fast, right!?
That's right!
Ryo, you can use Aggressive Beast Mode now, right?
Yeah, it's been tuned. Now it's just a matter of how well we use it.
...Here we go.
Here they come...! Take them out one at a time. Stay focused.
Roger!
Leave it to me!
We've got no choice.
If we don't hold them here...
The question is how far we can close the gap in strength.
Yeah, let's do this.
Hmph, you don't have to tell me! Let's do it!
Aw, man, there's still more of them?
Ugh, they're such a pain!
If they swarm us, we're in trouble... We can't beat their sheer numbers.
That huge Einst from before had better not show up.
If it doesn't, all the better...
With what we've got, we'd never win.
Right. But even just this is rough on us alone, isn't it?
Commander, if you're coming, hurry it up.
This is tough, I admit... But...!
...That battleship!?
The Gandor!
You're late, old man Hazuki!
Sorry. What's the situation?
Everyone but us has started going inside on the Nadesico.
I made contact with Bright earlier and heard the gist of the plan.
But the Einst series...
Very well... The Gandor unit will engage at once.
...!? Commander, more enemies incoming! Einst readings again!?
Those things!?
After the Dancougar, now a fake Alteisen...
They must really want to slam this plant into Earth.
Real hard workers, aren't they. Anyway, let's smash 'em, Ryo.
We can't leave the ones who went ahead on their own forever!
All right, let's roll out!
All units, sortie!
(A fake Alt, huh. The red one... Alchemie doesn't seem to be here...)
So you've come... Amuro.
Char...!
Judau!
Amuro, Kamille! I've been waiting for you!
Looks like the whole cast is here.
Let's push all the way!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Have you confirmed all enemies are destroyed!?
Yeah, we didn't miss any... Let's head in too.
Same as ever, huh, Fujiwara.
Oh, so you're still alive.
What's that!? You jerk, and here I came to help you...
Shinobu!
Pai! Quit rising to every bit of bait!
Oh, things are getting lively!
Now it's starting to feel right.
Hey, hey!
Never mind that, getting into the plant planet comes first, right?
There are a lot of people I haven't met, but...
No time for introductions, huh.
Anyway, we have to catch up with Londo Bell, who went on ahead...
Exactly. All units, return to the Gandor.
...We now begin the descent operation...!
Kyosuke... there's something I have to tell you...
It's about Excellen... isn't it?
Yes... It happened once before, too, but...
before we went in, she sortied in the Weissritter on her own...
What the hell!? She's not here!?
No wonder I haven't seen her.
I can't pick up her ID signal nearby... What happened?
What? What's wrong?
Excellen... she's gone.
What!? Fujiwara! What the hell's going on!?
Shut up! I only found out afterward myself!
Excellen... she's been acting strange lately...
They said the Weissritter flew off toward the dark zone...
The dark zone...?
Where the Stone Circle is, where we met up with Hibiki...
What kind of place is it?
I don't really know... but we've run into the Einst there before.
The Einst again... What is it with you two lovebirds, anyway?
Hayato! Think about how Kyosuke must feel!
Let's keep moving.
Huh?
...I can't do anything right now. I can't wreck the place she'll return to.
Knowing her, she'll be fine... lover boy.
(I hope so...)
